description: A permission prompt whose buttons read Allow / Deny instead of Yes / No: the agent asks to fetch a page. It is still an approval, so the card restates what approving does. Invented screen.
capture:
[visible screen]
● I'll read the changelog for the date parser before upgrading it.

────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 Fetch
   https://example.org/datewise/CHANGELOG.md
   Read the release notes for datewise 4.0

 Allow Claude to fetch this page?
 ❯ 1. Allow
   2. Allow for this domain
   3. Deny

 Esc to cancel

question.ask: The agent wants to fetch a file from the internet. Continue?

expected.headline: Asking permission to fetch the datewise changelog
